ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Desktop Background Change Using Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of "reg.exe" to alter registry keys that would replace the user's desktop background.
This is a common technique used by malware to change the desktop background to a ransom note or other image.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Control\\ Panel\\\\Desktop.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\ActiveDesktop.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System.*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ NoChangingWallpaper.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ 1.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ Wallpaper.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/t\\ REG\\_SZ.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ WallpaperStyle.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ 2.*")))
